title: One-Sided Chore Drift Alert
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=relationship:checkin chore_share_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(my_share_pct) as my_share, avg(partner_share_pct) as partner_share by _time
| eval imbalance=round(abs(my_share-partner_share),1)
| where imbalance>20
| sort - _time
description: Flags weeks where household work starts tilting too heavily to one side.
value: Chore imbalance builds resentment gradually; a simple percentage gap catches it before it becomes the whole conversation.
implementation: Capture rough chore-share estimates during relationship check-ins; alert when weekly imbalance passes your chosen threshold.
visualization: Weekly line chart of each person’s chore share with imbalance highlighting.
grandmaExplanation: It checks when household work starts leaning too much onto one person, before that turns into quiet resentment.
